header: This serves a plant document. I kept Next.js out of it so that it can be tested: the route src/app/api/history-docs/[doc]/route.ts hands its request and the real dependencies to `serveDoc`.

* An internal document (a JO Manual): a reader who is not signed in gets 401 and is told to sign in (the viewer then shows its Sign in button). A published PDF (Steel Cities, an annual report...) is public: no sign-in. The address of the file in Vercel Blob never leaves the server.
* An unknown document id is 404, and so is a document that has not been uploaded yet.

* ?info=1 answers {title, pages, bytes} as JSON; otherwise the PDF, inline. A Range request (the browser's PDF viewer asks for the pages it needs) is passed to Blob and answered 206, so that a page far into a manual opens at once without the whole file being sent first.

behaviours: an unknown document is 404 (even for a signed-in reader), and a prototype name is not a document
not signed in: 401 with a message that says to sign in, and no file is fetched
a document not uploaded yet is 404 with a message that says so
?info=1 answers the title, the pages (49) and the bytes as JSON; it fetches nothing
a signed-in reader gets the PDF inline, whole, as application/pdf, with Accept-Ranges and no caching
a Range request is passed on and answered 206 with its Content-Range (so a far page opens without the whole file)
a Range the route does not understand (several ranges) is not passed on
when Blob cannot be read: 502 and a message to try again
a published PDF (Steel Cities) is served to a reader who is not signed in, from its copy in Blob, with the Range passed on (206)
an internal manual still needs the sign-in while a published PDF does not (the same route, the same answer to a reader who is not signed in: 401 against 206)
?info=1 of a published PDF answers its title and its size
only the documents listed in docs.ts can be served: an address typed as the id is 404 and fetches nothing
the address in Vercel Blob is in no header and no body the reader gets
the two manuals in the source table are the documents on file: jo-086 and jo-089 (and the page links are our route's); every published PDF the card cites has its entry, with its own address
every cited manual page is a page of that manual (1 to its last)
